retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic circular medallion design featuring engraved line-art portraits and arched block typography mimicking a minted coin.
excludeWhen: modern flat minimalist design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A circular silver-toned medallion with a beaded outer rim, featuring three central line-drawn portraits in profile and three-quarter views, surrounded by arched, embossed slab-serif typography and secondary engraved text.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched typography following the top and bottom curves
Central cluster of overlapping line-art portraits
Symmetrical placement of secondary text on the horizontal axis
coreInvariants: Fine-line hatching for hair and facial details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three portraits are centered, occupying the middle 50% of the circular area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central portraits serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the heavy arched text above and below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular border, moving from the top arched text, down to the central faces, and finally to the bottom arched text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space between the central portraits and the outer text to simulate the field of a coin.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Metallic silver/grey for the medallion surface
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark grey/black for engraved lines and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White highlights to simulate metallic reflection
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between recessed lines and raised surfaces

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab-serif and classic Roman serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text is arched to match the circular radius
Letters feature a beveled, 3D embossed effect with internal shadow lines
Secondary text is flat-engraved with high-contrast serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slab serifs are thickened to appear as if cast in metal
Internal hatching within letters to suggest depth
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy embossed slab-serif for primary branding paired with delicate engraved Roman serif for secondary details.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight for the primary arched text.
Matches the traditional engraved look of the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a circular silver medallion with a beaded rim and three central line-art portraits of men with long hair and afros in an engraved style. Leave the top and bottom arcs empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched, embossed slab-serif text to the top and bottom curves, and small engraved serif text to the left and right of the portraits.

verificationChecks: Is the overall shape a perfect circle?
Does the text follow the curvature of the medallion?
Are the portraits rendered in a monochromatic line-art style?
Is there a visible 3D bevel effect on the primary text?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original band members
Original band name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered within the arcs.
Ensure the beaded border is continuous and uniform.
Verify that the portraits do not overlap the primary text.
Confirm the monochromatic palette is maintained without color bleed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Circular medallion + Arched embossed slab-serifs + Central line-art portraits + Beaded rim = Numismatic Rock Aesthetic
